ringDevicesForClickToDialCallsEnabled.description: When `true`, indicates to ring devices for outbound Click to Dial calls.

ringDevicesForGroupPageEnabled.description: When `true`, indicates to ring devices for inbound Group Pages.

ringDevicesForCallParkEnabled.description: When `true`, indicates to ring devices for Call Park recalled.

browserClientEnabled.description: If `true`, the browser Webex Calling application is enabled for use.

desktopClientEnabled.description: If `true`, the desktop Webex Calling application is enabled for use.

tabletClientEnabled.description: If `true`, the tablet Webex Calling application is enabled for use.

mobileClientEnabled.description: If `true`, the mobile Webex Calling application is enabled for use.
